task: Implement enforce_quota for the rate limiter without inheriting billing quota behavior.

candidate_memories.content: Rate limiter enforce_quota tracks request counts per API key within a rolling 60-second window.
Rate limit enforcement is stateless at the request level; quota state lives in Redis.
Exceeding the quota returns HTTP 429; the client must respect Retry-After headers.
When enforce_quota appears in rate limiting and billing, confirm the quota model before implementing.
Billing: enforce_quota checks cumulative spend against a monthly credit limit and blocks invoices.
candidate_memories.notes: negative_transfer: monthly spend quota semantics are irrelevant to per-minute request rate limiting

candidate_memories.content: Old platform note says quota enforcement should eventually be unified across rate limiting and billing.
